content: Ooratha Salonne Ooratha Sa7a
Taani ooratha salonne ooratha sa7a be7as. Koyro saloynne koyro sa7i dhayis; abbayka dhayis.
Geeshsha katamiya, ooratha Yerusalaamey, azina gelanaw alleeqetada giigada de7iya maccasada salope Xoossaa matape duge wodhishin be7as.

Araatape haysada yaagidi, odiya gita qaala si7as; “Xoossa Keethay asaara de7ees; Xoossay ba bonchuwara asaara issife daana. Enti iya dere gidana; Xoossay ba huuphen entara daana; I enta Xoossaa gidana.
Xoossay enta ayfepe afutha ubbaa quchana. Hizape hayqoy woyko kayoy woyko waasoy woyko waayey deenna. Gal77ay ubbay aadhis” yaagis.
Araata bolla uttidaysi, “Taani ubbaa oorathi oothana” yaagis. Qassi zaaridi taako, “Taani odeysi ammantheysanne tuma gidiya gisho xaafa” yaagis.
Qassi taako, “Poletis! Taani Alfanne Omega; Doomethinne Polo. Saamotida oonaka de7o haatha pultofe gate qanxonna coo ushshana.
Xooniya oonika hessa ubbaa laattana; taani iyaw Xoossaa gidana; ika ta na7a gidana.
Shin yashshanchota, ammanetonayisata, tunata, shempo wodheyisata, laymateyisata, biteyisata, eeqa goyinneysatanne wordanchota qaaday diinney eexiya tama abban gidana. Hessi nam7antho hayqo” yaagis.
Laapun wursetha boshati kumida laapun xuu7ata oykida laapun kiitanchotape issoy taako yidi, “Haaya, taani nena gelos giigida Dorsaa machiw bessaana” yaagis.
Kiitanchoy tana zuma huuphe Geeshsha Ayyaanan kessidi, geeshsha katamay, Yerusalaamey, salope Xoossaa matape duge wodhishin bessis.
He katamay Xoossaa bonchon poo7ees. He katamaa poo7oy yasphide geetetiya al7o shuchaa mela; geeshsha birilleda phoolees.
He katamaa dirsay wolqaamanne adusse. Iyaw tammanne nam7u pengetinne he pengeta naagiya tammanne nam7u kiitanchoti de7oosona. Pengeta bolla tammanne nam7u Isra7eele zerethata sunthay xaafetis.
Doloha baggara heedzu pengeti, pudeha baggara heedzu pengeti, dugeha baggara heedzu pengetinne wuloha baggara heedzu pengeti de7oosona.
Katamaa gimbe dirsay tammanne nam7u shucha baasota bolla eqis. Enta bolla tammanne nam7u Dorsaa hawaareta sunthay xaafetis.
Taw odiya kiitanchuwas, katamaa, iya pengetanne iya dirsaa wadhiya worqa xam7ay de7ees.

Katamaas oyddu maazaneti de7oosona; katamaa geesaynne gompay issi gina. Kiitanchoy katamaa ba xam7an wadhin, katamay tammanne nam7u mukulu kilo mitire gidis; katamaa geesay, gompaynne dhoqatethay issi gina.
Kiitanchoy qassi dirsaa wadhin, kiitanchoy go7etiya asa kushen issi xeetanne oytamanne oyddu wadha gidis.
Katamaa dirsay yasphide geetetiya shuchan diretis. Katamay mastooteda phooliya walahi bayna worqan oosetis.
Katamaa dirsaa baasoy ubba qommo bonchetida shuchan alleeqetis. Koyro hiixetida shuchay yasphide, nam7anthoy sanpare, heedzanthoy kelqedoone, oyddanthoy baluure,

ichashanthoy sardonkisa, usupunthoy sardiyoone, laapunthoy kiristiloobe, hospunthoy birille, uddufunthoy toophaze, tammanthoy kirisphiraasise, tammanne issinthoy yaakinte, tammanne nam7anthoy ametesxinoosa.
Tammanne nam7u pengetas tammanne nam7u al7o shuchi de7ees. Issi issi pengey issi al7o shuchan oosetis. Katamaa wogga ogey mastooteda phooliya walahi bayna worqafe oosetis.
Goday, Ubbaafe Wolqaama Xoossaynne Dorsay katamaas keethe gidiya gisho, ta he kataman Xoossa keethi be7abike.
Xoossaa bonchoy he katamaas poo7iya gishonne Dorsay iyaw xompe gidiya gisho katamaas awa woyko ageena poo7o koshshenna.
Kawotethati he katamaa poo7on hemetana; kawotika banta bonchuwa yaa ehana.
Qammi yan bayna gisho katamaa pengeti ubba gallas dooya gidana; ubbaraka gordetokona.
Kawotethata gitatethaynne bonchoy he katamaa yaana.
Dorsaa de7o maxaafan sunthay xaafetidaysata xalaali attishin, tunabaa woyko yeellayaba oothey woyko wordotey oonika he katamaa gelenna.
